A quantum state of three qubits which has the following shape: |W⟩=1/(√3)(|001⟩+|010⟩+|100⟩). It is remarkable for representing a specific type of multipartite entanglement and for occurring in several applications in quantum information theory.

(computer graphics) A kind of inverted z-buffer, storing inverse depth values, which has some advantages for interpolation and precision scaling.
(computer graphics) The use of a w-buffer.
(metonymic) Characterized by traits whose graphing produces curves with that shape.
(economics, idiomatic) An economic downturn where key indicators such as GDP and employment plummet sharply, briefly rebound, dip again, and then recover fully, forming a W pattern on a chart.
(computing) In natural language processing, a set of unique "shingles" (contiguous subsequences of tokens in a document) that can be used to gauge the similarity of documents.
(medicine) An abnormal posture in which a person sits with their knees forward and feet splayed outward.
(humorous) Any word beginning with the letter w that is not normally taboo but is considered (often humorously) to be so in the given context, such as the word work or woman.
